audit_items.proof_trace: The deduplication check (hasSeenDataColumnIndex at L157) and the seen-flag update (setSeenDataColumnIndex in subscriber at L42) are not atomic. Two concurrent P2P messages with identical (slot, proposer_index, index) can both pass the check before either sets the flag, violating the uniqueness invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends duplicate DataColumnSidecars via P2P with identical (slot, proposer_index, index) in rapid succession. Both pass validation concurrently before either subscriber updates the cache, causing duplicate acceptance and downstream resource exhaustion or state inconsistency.
